name: longeviq
description: LongevIQ - Your AI Health Copilot for a Longer, Healthier Life.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @longeviq/api" "npm run dev -w @longeviq/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @longeviq/shared && npm run build -w @longeviq/api && npm run build -w @longeviq/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @longeviq/shared && npm run typecheck -w @longeviq/api && npm run typecheck -w @longeviq/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @longeviq/api && npm run lint -w @longeviq/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @longeviq/api && npm run test -w @longeviq/web
